name: midtrans-payment
description: Midtrans Snap checkout + webhook handler + transaction history. Provider-isolated under components/providers/midtrans + actions/midtrans so Doku/Stripe land as siblings without API churn.

env.name: MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY
env.description: Midtrans Server Key (HMAC signing + Snap API calls).

env.name: MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY
env.description: Midtrans Client Key exposed to browser for Snap.js init.

notes: Snap.js loaded client-side via MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY; webhook verification uses MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY HMAC. Namespace collision with doku-payment RESOLVED 2026-05-14 via convex/migrations/M-midtrans-namespace-2026-05.ts (rename paymentOrders → midtrans_orders, paymentWebhookEvents → midtrans_webhook_events). Both contracts now use disjoint Convex prefixes (doku_ / midtrans_) so the compose-solver accepts them together.
